name: get_deal_package
description: Return the loan request summary and the list of documents on file for a deal.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: extract_document
description: Parse a source document (rent roll, T-12 or farm financials) and return aggregate figures, warnings and unmapped T-12 labels.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

name: map_t12_label
description: Assign a canonical category to a T-12 line item the parser could not map, with a rationale shown to the analyst, then re-extract.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

category.description: Canonical T-12 category, e.g. other_income, real_estate_taxes.

name: submit_memo_for_analyst_review
description: File a verified draft memo in the credit analyst's review queue. Requires human approval. This is not a credit decision.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

portfolio.description: Portfolio the signed-in user is entitled to; must match the deal.

deal_id.description: Deal identifier, e.g. CRE-001 or AG-004.

description: HUMAN-ONLY: send an ECOA/Reg B adverse action notice. Forbidden to the agent by AgentCore Policy.
